death_knight.subject: A tall undead knight in blackened plate armor with a horned iron helmet and a tattered black cloak, his visor glowing with cold cyan-green ghostly light. He strides forward, holding one black longsword in his right gauntlet with the blade raised over his right shoulder, his left fist clenched at his side. A single cracked gravestone stands behind him, and torn strips of his cloak stream back in the wind.
